# Zoomed line

The chart is read after two zoom steps; its readouts must name the visible x values.

```chart
type: line
title: Two series to zoom
data:
  inline:
    - {d: 1, s: North, v: 4.37}
    - {d: 1, s: South, v: 48.09}

    - {d: 5, s: South, v: 40.45}
```
